evidence.quote: Our main Clients are in the downstream sector (refining and petrochemical) but we also work in partnership for some upstream projects. || SB SETEC’s in-house work force provides 300,000 engineering man-hours per year, which can be increased to 400.000 by mobilizing sub-contractors that are strictly cooperating with us. || Our main Clients are in the downstream sector (refining and petrochemical) but we also work in partnership for some upstream projects.
